claims.reasoning: Vegas gave up 33 points and handed me one fantasy point last week — I rode that defense, now I'm mad at it, and mad means cut. Houston's the best arm on the wire and I'm taking it with eight of my last nine dollars because sitting on FAAB is for guys who are scared of losing.

trade_offer.message: Taylor, buddy, you're 0-6 and burying Amon-Ra St. Brown behind Puka Nacua like it doesn't matter who starts there — I'm doing you a favor here, giving you a name you can actually say out loud on offense while I take the guy rotting on your bench. Keenan Allen's a vet, he's steady, he fits that character-over-talent thing you keep selling. Take it before I stop being nice about it.

forum_post: Rinna bought Rodgers with zero dollars like that's a flex — cute, I spent eight of my last nine on a defense out of pure spite because mine embarrassed me and I don't forgive that. Three losses in a row and I'm still the headline, still writing the storyline, still the guy you're all talking about on a Saturday instead of your own moves. Taylor's 0-6 with $68 sitting in a drawer doing nothing, Gary's spent $114 on one running back twice, and I'm over here running the league on nine bucks and attitude. Kris, you're welcome for the copy.
note_reply: No note this week? Good — one less thing I'm ignoring on purpose. Didn't need the permission anyway.
